# Mason

## Doctors of Physical Therapy

### Welcome to DPT - Mason!

At our Mason Michigan location, we go out of our way to make your physical rehabilitation and recovery a great experience. If you do not have a prescription – no problem! Direct Access means you get to choose where you go for treatment. We’ll work closely with you and your physician to develop an individualized treatment plan that works for you in your life. We can even refer you to a great physician, if needed.

We will do everything in our power to accommodate your busy schedule. All of our locations have flexible hours to help you get the physical therapy you need, when you need it. We’re here to help you get better, faster!

Our friendly staff is happy to walk you through necessary paperwork and assist in any way possible, including insurance questions and scheduling. We’ll even call your insurance company for you to help you understand your benefits.

We can’t wait to see you!

### Find us Here

125 E. Kipp Rd.

Suite B

Mason, MI 48854

### Get In touch

Phone: 517-969-6609

Fax: 517-200-7006

### Clinic Hours

Mon: 8am- 6pm

Tues: 7:30am- 6:30pm

Wed: 8am- 6pm

Thurs: 10am-6:30pm

Fri: 7:30am- 4pm

Saturday: Closed

Sunday: Closed
